Those therefore who had perverted the Galatians, wishing to avoid these persecutions, persuaded the disciples to circumcision as a defence. Therefore the cross is fixed on the forehead of believers, where is the seat of shame, that faith may not blush at his name and may love the glory of God rather than that of men. The sign of the Old Testament was circumcision in hidden flesh, the sign of the New is the cross on the open forehead: for there is concealment, here revelation; that is under a veil, this is in the face.
